entities.name: Karl Niklaus Lang
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karl Nikolaus Lang was a Swiss physician and naturalist who collected fossils and questioned explanations based on the Biblical floods but came up with his own hypothesis that fossils were formed from seeds into the ground.
